title: JFK briefed at Los Alamos

tellings.quote: And then JFK, I think a couple weeks later, a few weeks later, ends up at Los Alamos getting briefed.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1962 President John F. Kennedy, a few weeks after some earlier event in the story, went to Los Alamos, the New Mexico laboratory where the US designs nuclear weapons, and was briefed there. Michels tells it on an episode about whether Kennedy knew secrets about UFOs, suggesting the briefing may have touched on them.
